escobar-sentipensar.why_zh: 「共感思」是 Escobar 全部工作的认识论枢纽：思考不是头脑的独白，而是身体、土地与共同体一起做出来的。
escobar-sentipensar.why_en: 'Sentipensar' is the epistemological hinge of Escobar's whole project: thinking is not a monologue of the head but something done by body, land and community together.

background.zh: 《与大地共感思》是一部西班牙语文集，汇集 Escobar 在 2000 年代至 2010 年代初关于发展、领地与差异的文章与讲演。书名取自哥伦比亚加勒比沿岸的民间说法 sentipensar——「用心思考」或「用身体感受着思考」，Escobar 从奥兰多·法尔斯·博尔达（Orlando Fals Borda）那里接过这个词，把它变成一种方法论：研究者不能只做旁观的分析者，必须让自己的身体与情感进入与土地、社区的关系。全书讨论四个问题：发展的替代、领地的政治、差异的本体论、以及「认识论南方」的可能。
background.en: Sentipensar con la tierra is a Spanish-language collection of essays and talks from the 2000s and early 2010s on development, territory and difference. The title takes a popular expression from Colombia's Caribbean coast — sentipensar, to think with the heart or to feel-think — which Escobar receives via Orlando Fals Borda and turns into a method: the researcher cannot remain a detached analyst but must let body and affect enter into relation with land and community. The book addresses four questions: alternatives to development, the politics of territory, the ontology of difference, and the possibility of an 'epistemology of the South'.
background.sources: Guide; book description; standard accounts of sentipensar
background.sources_en: Guide; book description; standard accounts of sentipensar

narrative.zh: 文集不是线性专著，而是围绕四个关键词反复推进的短章：先批评「发展」的单一尺度，再讨论领地如何成为生命世界的政治，然后把「差异」从文化概念提升为本体论问题，最后提出「共感思」作为一种认识论姿态。篇章之间有重复，也有修订，读者可以把它当作 Escobar 思想的「工作台」——许多后来在《多元宇宙的设计》中成形的概念，在这里还带着草稿的痕迹。
narrative.en: The collection is not a linear monograph but short chapters circling four keywords: a critique of development's single scale, territory as the politics of a lifeworld, difference raised from culture to ontology, and sentipensar as an epistemological stance. There is repetition and revision across chapters; readers can use it as Escobar's workbench, where many concepts later formalised in Designs for the Pluriverse still carry the marks of draft.

intent.reception_good_zh: 在西语学界与拉丁美洲研究圈内影响很大，「共感思」成为去殖民方法论的常用词；它也让英语读者看到 Escobar 思想更口语、更介入的一面。
intent.reception_good_en: It has had wide influence in Spanish-language scholarship and Latin American studies; sentipensar became a common term in decolonial methodology, and the book shows English readers a more spoken, more engaged Escobar.
intent.reception_bad_zh: 作为文集，结构松散、篇章重复；「共感思」的诗性定义也常被批评为难以操作，容易变成姿态而非方法。
intent.reception_bad_en: As a collection it is loosely structured and repetitive, and the poetic definition of sentipensar is often criticised as hard to operationalise, risking stance over method.
intent.syn_zh: 本书的价值不在体系，而在姿态：它提醒研究者，关于土地与差异的知识不能只从外部描述，必须在关系中被共同生产。
intent.syn_en: Its value lies not in system but in stance: it reminds researchers that knowledge about land and difference cannot be described only from outside but must be co-produced in relation.

reception.then_zh: 2010 年代中期在西语学界流传，随后随「去殖民转向」进入英语世界的课程与读本。
reception.then_en: It circulated in Spanish-language scholarship in the mid-2010s and entered English-language courses and readers with the decolonial turn.
reception.later_zh: 后世把它视为 Escobar 从领地民族志走向「多元宇宙」理论的过渡文本，「共感思」也成为方法论文献中的高频词。
reception.later_en: Later work treats it as the bridge from Escobar's territorial ethnography to pluriversal theory, and sentipensar became a frequent term in methodological writing.
reception.influence_zh: 它推动了「知识生产的位置性」在拉丁美洲研究中的讨论，也影响了参与式行动研究的方法反思。
reception.influence_en: It advanced discussion of the situatedness of knowledge production in Latin American studies and shaped methodological reflection on participatory action research.
reception.critique_zh: 主要保留是：文集结构松散、重复较多；「共感思」的定义诗意而难以操作；对具体制度与政策的分析较少。
reception.critique_en: The main reservations are the loose, repetitive structure, the poetic and hard-to-operationalise definition of sentipensar, and the limited analysis of concrete institutions and policy.

author_intent.claim_en: Escobar wants to show that knowledge about development, territory and difference cannot be described only from outside but must be co-produced in the relation of body, affect and land; sentipensar is therefore an epistemological stance, not rhetoric.

review.title_zh: 用心思考土地：读《与大地共感思》
review.title_en: Thinking the land with the heart
review.standfirst_zh: 「共感思」不是诗意的装饰，而是 Escobar 全部工作的认识论枢纽。
review.standfirst_en: Sentipensar is not poetic decoration but the epistemological hinge of Escobar's whole project.
review.body_zh:
如果要找一本能解释 Escobar 为什么这样写作的书，《与大地共感思》比《遭遇发展》更合适。它不是一部体系之作，而是一部工作台之书：讲演、短文、序言与回应被放在一起，反复打磨几个词——发展、领地、差异、共感思。

「共感思」（sentipensar）是全书的核心。这个词来自哥伦比亚加勒比沿岸的民间说法，意思是「用心思考」或「带着感受去思考」。Escobar 经 Fals Borda 接过它，用它反对两种知识姿态：一种是抽离的、只做描述的社会科学；另一种是只讲立场的、拒绝分析的宣言。他要的是一种既不放弃分析、也不假装中立的写法。

这本书的力量在于姿态，局限也在于姿态。文集的结构松散，篇章之间重复不少；「共感思」的定义诗意而难以操作，读者很难从中学到一套可复制的步骤。它更像一次邀请：请你在读土地、读领地、读差异时，把自己的身体与情感也算进知识里。

把它当作《多元宇宙的设计》的前传读，会看见许多后来被系统化的概念还带着草稿的痕迹。这种草稿感不是缺点，而是它最诚实的地方。
review.abstract_en:
If you want a book that explains why Escobar writes the way he does, Sentipensar con la tierra is a better guide than Encountering Development. It is not a systematic work but a workbench book: talks, short essays, prefaces and responses gathered to polish a few words — development, territory, difference, sentipensar.

Sentipensar is the core. The term comes from Colombia's Caribbean coast and means to think with the heart, or to think while feeling. Escobar receives it through Fals Borda and uses it against two postures: detached social science that only describes, and manifesto-style writing that refuses analysis. What he wants is a writing that neither abandons analysis nor pretends to neutrality.

The book's strength is its stance, and so is its limit. The collection is loosely structured and repetitive; the definition of sentipensar is poetic and hard to operationalise, and readers will not extract a replicable procedure. It is closer to an invitation: when reading land, territory and difference, count your body and affect as part of the knowledge.

Read as a prequel to Designs for the Pluriverse, it shows many later systematised concepts still carrying draft marks. That draft quality is not a defect but the most honest thing about it.

escobar-designs-pluriverse.why_zh: Escobar 的代表作：设计不是造物，而是造世界；如果世界是多元的，设计就必须从「为一个世界做方案」转向「为多个世界的共存做条件」。
escobar-designs-pluriverse.why_en: Escobar's major work: design is not making objects but making worlds; if worlds are plural, design must shift from 'solving for one world' to 'making conditions for the coexistence of many'.

background.zh: 《多元宇宙的设计》写于 Escobar 在哥伦比亚、北卡罗来纳与欧洲多所院校任教与合作的时期，是他在设计研究、人类学与政治本体论之间的综合之作。他关心的不是产品设计，而是「设计」作为一种本体论实践：现代性把世界设计成单一版本（发展、增长、技术），并以此抹平其他世界的存在。Escobar 因此提出「为多元宇宙而设计」：不是为所有人设计同一个未来，而是为不同世界的共存设计条件。书的对话对象包括设计研究（Papanek、Manzini、Fry）、本体论人类学（Viveiros de Castro、Descola）与自主政治（Castoriadis、自治主义）。
background.en: Designs for the Pluriverse was written while Escobar taught and collaborated in Colombia, North Carolina and Europe, and it synthesises design studies, anthropology and political ontology. Its concern is not product design but design as an ontological practice: modernity designed a single version of the world — development, growth, technology — and flattened other worlds in the process. Escobar therefore proposes 'design for the pluriverse': not one future designed for everyone but the design of conditions for different worlds to coexist. Its interlocutors include design studies (Papanek, Manzini, Fry), ontological anthropology (Viveiros de Castro, Descola) and the politics of autonomy (Castoriadis, autonomism).

narrative.zh: 全书分三部分：先诊断——现代性如何通过设计把世界单一化，设计与发展如何共谋；再理论——引入政治本体论、关系性与「多元宇宙」，说明世界是如何被做出来的；最后实践——从拉丁美洲的领地运动、社区设计与自主实践中提炼「为多元宇宙而设计」的原则。Escobar 不提供工具箱，而是提供一组姿态与判准：设计应服务于自主、公共性与生命的维持，而不是抽象的效率。
narrative.en: Three parts: diagnosis — how modernity singularised the world through design and how design colluded with development; theory — political ontology, relationality and the pluriverse, explaining how worlds are made; practice — principles of 'design for the pluriverse' distilled from Latin American territorial movements, community design and autonomous practice. Escobar offers no toolbox but a set of stances and criteria: design should serve autonomy, the communal and the maintenance of life rather than abstract efficiency.

intent.reception_good_zh: 2018 年出版后成为设计研究、人类学与后发展研究的交叉核心文本；「为多元宇宙而设计」被设计学院、社会创新与去殖民设计广泛采用。
intent.reception_good_en: Published in 2018, it became a crossroads text for design studies, anthropology and post-development; 'design for the pluriverse' was widely taken up in design schools, social innovation and decolonial design.
intent.reception_bad_zh: 批评主要有三：一，设计被赋予了过重的本体论使命，具体项目难以承载；二，「多元宇宙」有时被用成口号，缺少对权力冲突的分析；三，对专业设计实践的操作指导偏少。
intent.reception_bad_en: Three criticisms recur: design is given an ontological burden that concrete projects can hardly carry; the pluriverse sometimes functions as a slogan without analysis of power conflict; and operational guidance for professional practice is thin.
intent.syn_zh: 本书的贡献是把设计从「解决问题」提升为「决定哪些世界可以存在」的问题，同时要求设计者放弃单一现代性的普遍主义。
intent.syn_en: The contribution is to raise design from problem-solving to the question of which worlds may exist, while asking designers to give up the universalism of a single modernity.

reception.then_zh: 2018 年出版后迅速进入设计学院与人类学系课程；评论视其为「去殖民设计」与「本体论设计」的奠基文本。
reception.then_en: Published in 2018, it quickly entered design schools and anthropology departments; reviews treated it as a founding text of decolonial and ontological design.
reception.later_zh: 后世把它与 Fry 的《Design as Politics》、Willis 的《Design Philosophy》、以及「设计人类学」并读；「为多元宇宙而设计」成为社会创新与可持续设计的口号。
reception.later_en: Later work reads it with Fry's Design as Politics, Willis's design philosophy and design anthropology; 'design for the pluriverse' became a slogan in social innovation and sustainable design.
reception.influence_zh: 本书让设计研究正式接入后发展与本体论政治，也让「自主」成为设计伦理的核心词。
reception.influence_en: It connected design studies to post-development and ontological politics and made autonomy a core term in design ethics.
reception.critique_zh: 主要保留是：本体论使命过重，具体项目难以承载；「多元宇宙」有时沦为口号；对专业设计的操作指导不足；对权力冲突与不可通约性的处理仍偏乐观。
reception.critique_en: The main reservations are the heavy ontological burden on concrete projects, the slogan-like use of the pluriverse, thin operational guidance for professional design, and an optimistic handling of power conflict and incommensurability.

author_intent.claim_zh: Escobar 要证明：设计不是中立的技术活动，而是决定哪些世界可以存在的本体论实践；因此设计必须从服务单一现代性，转向为多个世界的共存与自主设计条件。
author_intent.claim_en: Escobar wants to show that design is not a neutral technical activity but an ontological practice deciding which worlds may exist; design must therefore turn from serving a single modernity to designing conditions for the coexistence and autonomy of many worlds.
author_intent.why_zh: 书名把「设计」放在「多元宇宙」之前，说明设计是入口而非对象；副标题三个词（相互依存、自主、世界生成）构成判准；全书从诊断到理论再到实践，说明作者要改变的是设计的目的论，而非技法。
author_intent.why_en: The title puts design before the pluriverse, making design the entry point rather than the object; the subtitle's three terms (interdependence, autonomy, world-making) form the criteria; the movement from diagnosis to theory to practice shows that what changes is design's teleology, not its techniques.

evidence.zh: 书名与副标题把设计、自主与世界生成绑定。
evidence.en: The title and subtitle bind design, autonomy and world-making together.

evidence.zh: 引入政治本体论，把设计问题提升为「什么算真实」。
evidence.en: Political ontology raises design to the question of what counts as real.

evidence.zh: 本书被设计学院广泛采用，说明其目标被理解为范式转换。
evidence.en: Its wide uptake in design schools shows the aim was understood as a paradigm shift.

author_intent.counter_zh: 另一种读法：本书是一套有力的设计伦理与本体论纲领，但其「多元宇宙」缺少对不可通约冲突的处理；把它当作可操作的设计方法，会高估其工程性。
author_intent.counter_en: Alternative reading: it is a powerful design ethics and ontological programme, but its pluriverse lacks a treatment of incommensurable conflict; treating it as an operational design method overestimates its engineering.

review.title_zh: 设计作为造世界：读《多元宇宙的设计》
review.standfirst_zh: 如果世界是多元的，设计就不能只为一种未来做方案，而要为多个世界的共存做条件。
review.standfirst_en: If worlds are plural, design cannot plan for one future; it must make conditions for many worlds to coexist.
review.body_zh:
《多元宇宙的设计》是 Escobar 最难被归类的书：它既不是设计手册，也不是人类学专著，而是一次把设计研究、政治本体论与后发展理论缝合起来的尝试。它的核心命题很简单：设计不是造物，而是造世界。每一次设计都在决定哪些生活方式被允许、哪些被边缘化、哪些根本不被看见。

这个命题的批判面指向现代性：发展、增长、技术效率，都是被设计出来的单一世界版本。Escobar 把这种单一化称为「一元宇宙」（universe）对「多元宇宙」（pluriverse）的压制。他的替代不是「更好的设计」，而是「为多元宇宙而设计」——为不同世界的共存设计条件，为共同体自我规定生活条件的能力（自主）设计支持。

这本书的力量在于视野，局限也在于视野。当设计被赋予「造世界」的使命时，具体的设计项目很难承载这样的重量；「多元宇宙」也容易被用成口号，而回避一个尖锐的问题：如果某个世界以伤害他人为基础，它还应被允许存在吗？Escobar 对这一点的回答并不充分。

尽管如此，这本书仍然是设计研究过去十年最重要的理论干预之一。它让设计者无法再假装自己只是解决问题的人。读它最好的方式，是把它当作一面镜子：你做的每一个设计决定，正在让哪些世界变得可能，又让哪些世界变得不可能？
review.abstract_en:
Designs for the Pluriverse is Escobar's hardest book to classify: neither a design manual nor an anthropology monograph, but an attempt to suture design studies, political ontology and post-development. Its core proposition is simple: design is not object-making but world-making. Every design decision decides which ways of life are permitted, which are marginalised, which are not seen at all.

The critical edge points at modernity: development, growth and technical efficiency are designed versions of a single world. Escobar calls this the suppression of the pluriverse by the universe. His alternative is not 'better design' but 'design for the pluriverse' — designing conditions for worlds to coexist and for communities to define the conditions of their own life (autonomy).

The strength is the vision, and so is the limit. When design is given the mission of world-making, concrete projects can hardly carry the weight; the pluriverse can also become a slogan that avoids a sharp question: if a world is founded on harming others, should it be allowed to exist? Escobar's answer is not fully developed.

Still, it is one of the most important theoretical interventions in design studies of the past decade. It makes it impossible for designers to pretend they only solve problems. The best way to read it is as a mirror: which worlds does each of your design decisions make possible, and which does it make impossible?
